map.基于Naranjo量表和卫生部ADR判定标准，评估药物与不良反应的因果关联性: Assesses the causal relationship between a drug and an adverse reaction based on the Naranjo scale and the ministry ADR criteria
map.⚠️ 本工具仅供药学专业人员参考，不替代临床判断。ADR报告请遵循医疗机构规范流: Warning: this tool is for pharmaceutical professionals only and does not replace clinical judgment. ADR reports should follow the standard process of the medical institution.
map.对以下10个问题逐项选择，系统自动评分并判定关联性等级: Answer the following 10 questions item by item; the system scores automatically and determines the causality grade
map.1. 开始用药时间与ADR出现时间有无合理的先后关系: 1. Is there a reasonable temporal sequence between the start of the drug and the onset of the ADR
map.2. ADR是否符合该药已知的ADR类型: 2. Does the ADR match the known ADR type of this drug
map.3. 停药或减量后ADR是否消失或减轻: 3. Does the ADR disappear or lessen after stopping or reducing the dose
map.4. 再次使用同一药物后ADR是否再次出现: 4. Does the ADR recur when the same drug is used again
map.5. ADR是否可用合并用药或病情进展解释: 5. Can the ADR be explained by concomitant medication or disease progression
map.前4条均为\"是\"，第5条为\"否\": The first 4 are "yes" and the 5th is "no"
map.前3条为\"是\"，第4条未试或不明，第5条为\"否\": The first 3 are "yes", the 4th is untried or unknown, and the 5th is "no"
map.前2条为\"是\"，第3条不明或未试，第4条未试，第5条可能: The first 2 are "yes", the 3rd is unknown or untried, the 4th is untried, and the 5th is possible
map.前2条为\"是\"，第3-5条不明或为\"否\": The first 2 are "yes" and the 3rd to 5th are unknown or "no"
map.📚 深度解析：ADR 关联性（10题加权）评估: 📚 In-depth analysis: ADR causality (10-item weighted) assessment
map.逐步勾 10 题，score 范围 -1~13；总分≥9 → 「肯定有关」；5-: Tick the 10 questions step by step, score range -1 to 13; total 9 or above gives "certain", 5-8 gives "probable", 1-4 gives "possible", 0 gives "doubtful" and -1 or below gives "impossible"; generate the ADR report text containing drug name, clinical presentation, causality grade and handling recommendations.
map.若任一题无 checked → unanswered++ → 报告提示「资料不全: If any question has no checked value then unanswered++ and the report flags "incomplete data" and downgrades the grade by one level; it is recommended to check past medication, rechallenge and blood concentration before finalizing the grade.
map.与 assessor-3 区别？: How does it differ from assessor-3?
map.tcm-adr-assessment 输出完整 PDF 报告（含未答项提示+处置: tcm-adr-assessment outputs a complete PDF report (including the unanswered item prompt and handling recommendations); assessor-3 only shows the 4-level grade and is used for quick screening by clinical pharmacists.
map.加权后分值怎么读？: How do I read the weighted score?
map.加权版对「时间合理性」「去激发 / 再激发」「既往文献报告」赋予更高权重，因此同: The weighted version gives higher weight to temporal plausibility, dechallenge/rechallenge and prior literature reports, so at the same total score a high score from key items means the causality is more reliable. When reading the score, look back at which items earned the points rather than only the total; if the points mainly come from weak evidence items such as "reported in the literature", then even a high total should be conservatively graded as "possible".
